discussion.body: Act 0 storyboard. Locations: Padon fields, the south road, WillowDale ferry landing. Cast on screen: Cael only. Beats: (1) Harvest morning, a north sky tick that the farmers call thunder out of season. (2) WillowDale ferryman will not cross after dark; he heard Iron's Gate is conscripting for a dwarven courtesy. (3) Night camp. Mist on a clear inland road. First fight against unformed veil-beasts. (4) Title. No temple entered. No recruit. No death flag. Purpose: teach walk, fight, and that the world already has a wrong weather. Frames for later boarding: road, ferry, mist camp, title.
